notes: Method: sample values are re-derived by a direct per-row scan of the raw CSVs; a second route (full state/county/NAICS/FY cube) re-derives every value of all 16 series; the two routes agree on 304 of 304 sampled cells. Neither route uses scripts/markets*.py or any data/markets file other than sources.json, geographies.json, naics-map.json and the register series being checked.

Sample design: seed 20261016, python random.Random(seed).random() only; 16 series x [2 us, 4 state, 3 single-county, 5 multi-county county-set, 2 cross-state or part, 3 CT component]; class drawn 20% 'all', 35% exact, 25% partial, 20% proxy; window drawn from the 5 windows (once each) and by_fy (3 slots) for additive series, pooled FY2011-2020 for rates; 75% of draws required a non-zero register value (so matches are not just zero equals zero), 25% unconstrained.
